description: Hover over an element (reveals dropdowns, tooltips, hover-triggered content). Pass ref from browser_snapshot (preferred) or a selector.

nthMatch.description: If the selector matches multiple elements, hover over the Nth (0-indexed).

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. "e12". Preferred over selector — exact match, no guessing.

selector.description: Playwright selector for the element to hover over (CSS, text="...", :has-text("..."), role=..., [data-testid="..."]). Fallback when you have no ref. NEVER use :contains().

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

textHint.description: Auto-heal: if the selector matches 0 elements, server retries with role=*[name~="<textHint>"].

name: browser_hover
